title: Coty launches Fragrance Club to reinforce fragrance knowledge
summary: Coty’s new ‘global community’, the Fragrance Club, will meet for discussions, workshops, immersive experiences and co-creation opportunities, sharing perspectives on consumer behaviour, innovation and cultural trends

extraction.key_fact: Coty가 향 이야기를 나누는 글로벌 커뮤니티 Fragrance Club을 시작했다
